standard.summary: 决定哪些子模块各自成为一个分片组：transformer（默认，按叶子模块逐层包装）、size（只包装直接参数量 ≥100 万的叶子）、none（只分片根模块）。
standard.effect: 过滤 leaf-first 选出的叶子清单。transformer 保持全部叶子；size 按直接参数量筛，小叶子归到父组；none 一个叶子都不单独包装，只对根做一次 fully_shard。
standard.whenToUse: 默认 transformer 适合绝大多数情况。层特别碎（大量小 norm/bias 模块）导致分片组过多、通信次数偏高时试 size。只想验证「分片本身」是否可行时用 none。
standard.avoidWhen: none 会让整个模型成为一个分片组，通信粒度最粗、峰值显存最高，不要当作省显存的选项。

optionDescriptions.transformer: 按 transformer block 逐个 shard（默认）。粒度和通信量的平衡点，绝大多数情况用它。
optionDescriptions.size: 按直接参数量阈值挑叶子模块 shard。模型不是标准 block 堆叠时才需要。
optionDescriptions.none: 只 shard 根模块，不下钻。通信最少、省显存也最少，基本只用来对比。

standard_en.summary: Decides which submodules become their own shard group: transformer (the default, wrapping leaf modules layer by layer), size (wrapping only leaves with at least a million direct parameters), none (sharding the root module alone).
standard_en.effect: It filters the leaf list that leaf-first selection produced. transformer keeps every leaf; size filters by direct parameter count and folds small leaves into their parent group; none wraps no leaf separately and calls fully_shard once on the root.
standard_en.whenToUse: The default transformer suits nearly every case. Try size when the layers are unusually fragmented (many small norm/bias modules), giving too many shard groups and too much communication. Use none when you only want to confirm sharding itself works.
standard_en.avoidWhen: none makes the entire model one shard group -- the coarsest communication granularity and the highest peak VRAM -- so do not treat it as a memory-saving option.

optionDescriptions.transformer: Shards transformer block by block (the default). The balance point between granularity and communication volume, and right for nearly every case.
optionDescriptions.size: Selects leaf modules to shard by a direct parameter-count threshold. Needed only when the model is not a standard stack of blocks.
optionDescriptions.none: Shards the root module only, without descending. The least communication and the least VRAM saved -- essentially a comparison baseline.

advanced.principle: FSDP2 的分片粒度由「谁被 fully_shard 包过」决定：每个被包装的模块在前向前 all-gather 自己那份参数、用完立即释放。包装粒度细则峰值显存低、通信次数多；粗则相反。本实现的叶子选择是「直接持有参数的子模块，按深度优先、冻结优先」，size 在这份清单上再按直接参数量筛一次。
advanced.intervention: distributed_fsdp_policy.py:apply_fsdp2_wrap_policy 过滤 select_fsdp2_leaf_modules 的结果；阈值 SIZE_POLICY_MIN_DIRECT_PARAMS=100 万写死在该模块里，理由是再加一个旋钮就又是一个「声明了没人读」的键。
advanced.expectedImpact: size 在层很碎的模型上减少分片组数量、降低通信次数，峰值显存略升；none 峰值显存最高。三种取值都不改变数值结果，只改变显存与通信的分布。
advanced.tradeoffs: 阈值不可配置是刻意的。真要按模型调，改的应该是 select_fsdp2_leaf_modules 的选择规则，而不是再加一个前端旋钮。
advanced.codePath: configs_base.py:fsdp_auto_wrap_policy 声明；distributed_runtime.py:select_fsdp2_leaf_modules 选叶子；distributed_fsdp_policy.py:apply_fsdp2_wrap_policy 按策略过滤；判据 fsdp2_shard_policy_contract_smoke.py

advanced_en.principle: FSDP2's sharding granularity is decided by "who got fully_shard-wrapped": each wrapped module all-gathers its own shard of parameters before forward and releases it immediately after use. Finer wrapping means lower peak VRAM but more communication rounds; coarser is the opposite. This implementation's leaf selection is "submodules that directly hold parameters, depth-first, frozen-first", with size filtering the list once more by direct parameter count.
advanced_en.intervention: distributed_fsdp_policy.py:apply_fsdp2_wrap_policy filters select_fsdp2_leaf_modules' results; the threshold SIZE_POLICY_MIN_DIRECT_PARAMS = 1M is hard-coded in that module — the reasoning being that one more knob would just be another "declared but never read" key.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: size reduces shard-group count and communication rounds on models with many small layers at slightly higher peak VRAM; none has the highest peak. None of the three values changes numerical results — only the distribution of VRAM and communication.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The non-configurable threshold is deliberate. To tune per model, change select_fsdp2_leaf_modules' selection rules rather than adding another front-end knob.
advanced_en.codePath: configs_base.py:fsdp_auto_wrap_policy declaration; distributed_runtime.py:select_fsdp2_leaf_modules leaf selection; distributed_fsdp_policy.py:apply_fsdp2_wrap_policy filters per policy; criterion fsdp2_shard_policy_contract_smoke.py
